name: Squat Jump from a Pause
setup: Stand tall, feet hip-width, arms ready to swing.
cues: Sit in the quarter squat for two seconds, then push the floor away hard with no dip.
Push the floor away hard and fast.
Land quiet: as little sound as you can.

faults.fault: Landing loud and stiff
faults.fix: Let the hips sit back as the floor arrives, quiet like a cat.

faults.fault: Knees caving in on the take-off or landing
faults.fix: Push the floor apart: the knees stay out over your laces.

faults.fault: Slow, sticky contacts in a repeated set
faults.fix: Touch the floor and leave it fast, like the floor is hot.

cautions: Plyometric: only once landings are quiet and stable. Count contacts, not sets.
